title: They Say We Hate White People

sense.text:
“And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.” This is the second greatest commandment. To love your neighbour is to love your race, to love your own people as you love yourself.

If you don’t love yourself, you cannot love your brother. That is the sickness our people suffer with in South Africa, in Nigeria, in Jamaica, in the Dominican Republic and here in America: the same sickness everywhere, self-hatred. They have a white mind, Oreo cookies, black on the outside and white on the inside. That is what lies behind the black-on-black crime and the hating of each other: brothers and sisters who hate themselves, and so cannot love their brother.

So when the Nigerian comes to South Africa, works hard and does well with a little business, jealousy and envy rise up against him. Nigeria gave billions to help free South Africa from apartheid, its civil servants gave part of their wages in what was called the Mandela tax, and students skipped lunch to give; and today young South Africans who never knew apartheid beat them and tell them to leave the country. The Nigerians and Ethiopians must not retaliate and play into the white man’s game: behind it all is the white man, the government, dividing our people so that he can conquer and colonize Africa again. Everyone in South Africa is not Israel, and not everyone there will repent, but our people there are mentally destroyed.

“Go not after thy lusts, but refrain thyself from thine appetites.” Every one who wakes up to the truth comes in with his own lusts and his own appetites, the things he desires. In repenting, God says go not after them.

To refrain means to control. Coming into the truth, you have to control the appetite and the lust that is in you; you cannot give in to it. Some like little girls, some like teenagers, some like men; some brothers like wearing their wife’s panties and women’s bras, some watch evil, nasty porn. If you are dealing with that, get rid of that evil, filthy spirit. A wife who wants to peg her husband defiles the bed: that is an appetite too.

Nobody is perfect, but you have to be fighting it, not giving in to it. If you need help, go and talk to somebody: I am fighting this, I am dealing with this.

“If thou givest thy soul the desires that please her, she will make thee a laughingstock to thine enemies that malign thee.” Give your soul what pleases it and your enemies will laugh at you.

So it was with the man whose wife, the head of immigration, was let go when it came out that he dressed like a woman, with pictures out there for the world to see; and with the man who was exposed over the talk with his wife about sexual toys. Nothing ever disappears. Whatever you look at, the white man knows; he sees the brother who calls himself a big bad Israelite teacher and what he is looking at, and one day he will blow his spot up. You freak, nasty brothers, get rid of that stuff, or everybody is going to laugh at you.

precepts.why:
“Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee.” The white man is wiser than Daniel, and there is no secret you can hide from him. That is why he has these devices: everything you type, everything you watch, is kept, and nothing disappears.

So the brothers watching porn: restrain yourself from your appetite, because the white man sees it, and eventually he will use it against you. Even a CIA agent warned never to put anything in a text message or on social media, not even as a joke, because it never disappears and it will be used against you.

Stop playing with these things. Get caught up in that child porn and you will go to jail, and don’t call us: the time to fix it was when you repented and came amongst us. These are dangerous spirits. You sit on your phone and think nobody sees you, and the white man is recording everything, waiting for you to click on the wrong video. That is how your enemies come to laugh at you.

“Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh. For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh.” There is a war going on inside of you: your flesh against your spirit, your spirit against your flesh.

“and these are contrary the one to the other”. You have the lusts of this world, porn and every other sin, and you have the word of God, and it is a fight to do good. “so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.”

Whatever you feed in that war grows strong. Keep entertaining it and it becomes something strong that dominates you and you cannot stop. A brother battling with putting on women’s underwear is battling an effeminate and a homosexual spirit; a brother watching that kind of porn is battling a gay spirit. You have to overcome these things. They will destroy your soul.

sense.text:
“But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence.” Wrought means it worked in me. Concupiscence is not a word our people know: it is strong desire, especially sexual desire; sex drive, lust, lustfulness, sexual passion, libido.

“All manner” means different types. Paul never said which kind he was dealing with; he kept it open. The point is that while Paul was doing the work, there were evil thoughts in his head.

precepts.why:
“I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.” Even while Paul was doing good, doing the work, there was always that reminder, that demon in him. “For I delight in the law of God after the inward man”: the inward man is the spirit of Christ.

“But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.” The law of sin was struggling in his mind. In doing the work there was a fight, and Paul opened up and spoke about it.

That is the problem among us. Some brothers are fighting and saying nothing; some are barely doing the work and entertaining the sin; some are doing some work and not even counseling. You cannot do this fight on your own, and the leadership cannot help you if you don’t speak up. Some are not battling at all: they gave up the fight and are getting stomped out, and when you ask who they counsel with, it is nobody. To them this is just a church. Some of these sins are so demonic that you will go to jail. That is why the brothers need to really fast.

sense.text:
Sins war against your soul; it is spiritual warfare, and Esau knows it. That is why the CIA and Amalek created porn and pushed it out there, so that it would work on us psychologically while we do the work.

“He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den”: that is the FBI, the CIA, all the alphabet boys. “he lieth in wait to catch the poor”. Esau is a master of psychology; he knows what is within a man, the things Christ spoke of in Mark 7 that lie in our thoughts. So he builds a society to activate the sin within you and lies in wait: a liquor store here, porn there, drugs in the community. Whatever your sin is, Esau creates a device to cater to it. All these things in society are traps to catch us.

“he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.” The net is the internet, the phone. It is a trap. Stay away from the net.

precepts.why:
When our sins are exposed, remember that Esau is God’s sword. “Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what ye think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.” We think we can hide our sins from God and from each other, but God knows every thought within us.

That is why we ask the brothers: do you have a counselor, have you talked about it? You try to hide your sin, thinking nobody sees you, but the Lord sees you, and Esau sees you too, and Esau is the Lord’s sword. “Therefore hath the Lord exactly searched out all your works, and he will put you all to shame. And when your sins are brought forth, ye shall be ashamed before men, and your own sins shall be your accusers in that day.”

So the Lord can use the white man. The man who calls himself a high priest takes a title of Christ; let us see if he measures up to the stature of Christ. Since he exalts himself rather than coming before the Lord humbly and confessing his sins, the Lord puts his sins out there: the white man has everything on the internet, and all your life is before everybody. That is why we have to overcome and ask for mercy, because the Lord will use the white man to expose us if we do not get over our sins.

sense.text:
“Know ye not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God?” If you are unrighteous, you are not going to inherit the kingdom of God, and what follows is unrighteousness.

Fornicators are those in sexual sins: sisters giving it up to the dudes out there, brothers paying for prostitutes and dealing with hoes. Idolaters: if you follow white Jesus, if you follow Christianity, you are not getting the kingdom. The effeminate is the man who walks twitching like a woman and runs his hand through his hair like a woman, acting like a girl. “abusers of themselves with mankind” is homosexuality: if you like men, you are not getting the kingdom of God.
Thieves, the covetous, drunkards, revilers and extortioners: whoever is any of these is not getting the kingdom of God.

“And such were some of you.” “Were” is past tense. In the church of Corinth there used to be extortioners, drunkards, effeminate men, abusers of themselves with mankind, adulterers, fornicators and idolaters. And such were all of us: we all came from different lifestyles, in the midst of whatever sin, before we heard this truth.

“but ye are washed”: now you are cleansed, because you repented and the spirit of Christ cleaned you up. “but ye are sanctified”: now you are holy. “but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus”: we are justified in Christ from all the evil, wicked things we did.

So we have to come to that next level and stop getting caught up in fornication and adultery. People sin because sin is pleasurable; it feels good. Now it is about training yourself to hate sin and getting rid of that dopamine you feel when you commit it. A man or woman sexually active their whole life comes to the truth and has to stop having that pleasure. This is where abstinence comes in, and it is not easy. This is where praying and fasting come in.

We are not a hate group, and we do not teach violence against any race, ethnicity or gender; anyone who talks of picking up weapons or doing harm should be reported and put out, because it is a setup: COINTELPRO is still alive and agents are amongst us to monitor and disrupt. They are often the ones who help with everything but don’t know the scriptures and have no joy of the Lord in them. You can memorize scripture, but you cannot fake the spirit of Christ; this walk is spiritual.

“Recompense to no man evil for evil.” When somebody does evil to us, we do not do evil back. The camp leaders and the brothers teaching on the street must not go back and forth arguing with the camp that follows us around to take our spots. If you get into an altercation, even if we are right, we are still wrong, because what Satan is trying to do is paint Israel in a bad light, as hateful and violent. Say shalom, record it and keep it moving.

The biggest downfall of men is ego; men are in prison because they felt disrespected and had to prove they were no punk. You don’t have to prove anything to anyone. Christ had all the power on the earth and did not have to prove it; we roll like our king. Having power and not using it does not make you soft.

“Provide things honest in the sight of all men.” We have to do things honestly, not shady, not robbing and stealing from people.

“If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.” If it be possible, because sometimes somebody breaks into your house trying to hurt your family and you have to defend yourself. Some of you have jobs: don’t be on your job hating everybody, walking around saying I hate you, I can’t stand you. We cannot roll in that spirit, but that is the spirit they are trying to paint on us, that we are hateful, that we are a cult.

“Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves.” Even back then there were zealots who rose up to fight against Rome; Paul says, do not take vengeance for yourself, “but rather give place unto wrath”, God’s wrath. A Christian reads the top, live peaceably with all men, and says you have to love everyone, and forgets the bottom, where God’s wrath is coming.

“for it is written, Vengeance is mine”. The Lord says, I am the one who takes vengeance on Esau, the white man, for all the evil done on the earth; that belongs to me first and foremost, and you will get the leftovers. So we are not to take up weapons and go and fight the white man, because vengeance belongs to God, and he will pay them back for the slavery, the stealing and the oppression our people go through. Leave it to God: he is coming with wrath and judgment on everybody that did evil on this earth.

precepts.why:
“And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.” This is the flip side of living peaceably with all men. Even though we live peaceably with all men, all men are going to hate us.

They will hate us for teaching the gospel, this good news, the teachings of Christ. So they say to the brothers at camp, why do you hate white people? The brother answered that he never said he hated white people; that is the stigma being put out there, the SPLC listing us as the number three largest hate group in America, and the talk shows putting us with the KKK.

But the KKK were governors, judges, police officers and politicians, and today they call themselves white Christian nationalists. We have never lynched anyone or killed anyone in the name of Jesus. This propaganda is put out to paint us as a hate group, so that when they come for us and kill us they can justify themselves. The government has new definitions of domestic terrorists, and the FBI has a category of black identity extremists, and they put us, the Israelites, under it, the same way COINTELPRO targeted the leaders of the civil rights movement and the Black Panthers, who fed children while the KKK hung children. The Panthers had their own food programs and their own clinics and nurses in the community; before integration we were self-sufficient, with our own towns, farms, schools and lawyers, and the KKK burned them down. That goes back to the curses: here we are doing good, and the white man comes and destroys everything. The same thing is coming back: the time is coming when you will not be able to go to the doctor any more, and we will have to rely on each other, on the brothers and sisters who are dentists and doctors and know how to farm. We have to become self-sufficient.

The leaders in IUIC will be hunted, some put in prison and some murdered, the same way the Panthers were infiltrated; the agents are already here. Should we pick up weapons and fight back? No: the Lord is going to take vengeance, and we are coming back with the Lord for vengeance. So you leaders had better become leaders and build yourselves up, and you sisters had better be ride or die and really believe what this Bible is talking about.

sense.text:
The brothers on the street are ambassadors of Christ, and Christ gave them a mission and a job. “For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal”: we are not to pick up weapons and go and fight anybody. But we are fighting a war, and all the brothers had better understand it. The weapon is not a gun or a grenade.

“but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. Your job is to pull down strongholds. There is a stronghold of Christianity, of white Jesus, on this earth, and your job as a soldier of Christ is to pull it down. The Lord said he would give us a mouth and wisdom that no man can gainsay or resist: when a white Christian runs up on you at camp, he should go home and have nightmares and question his whole belief. Cast down that imagination.

If a camp leader lets a Christian do him dirty and makes our king look bad, it means he is weak and not studying and does not understand that this is war. If you are scared, don’t go to camp; hold post and be quiet, and leave the teaching to the soldiers who are hungry, who get excited when they see our apologetics and have been waiting for a Christian to test them. If somebody comes at you with a camera and asks what color Jesus Christ is, use the word of God and destroy that demon.

They ask, do you hate white people? Malcolm X answered that it takes a whole lot of nerve for white people, after kidnapping millions from Africa and making them cattle and merchandise, to ask the Negro if he hates them. They ask the question to test your temperature, to see how much history you know. Ask them if they hate Hitler and they will say yes; but when it comes to us, they ask, do you hate white people?

“As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” God says he loved Jacob and hated Esau. Esau is the so-called white man. If you ask why God hates the white man, look at his history, at what he has done ever since he came into power as the Greeks, right through history. If you were a god, wouldn’t you hate him too? So who hates Esau? God hates Esau.

precepts.why:
“And I hated Esau.” That is where it is first written. “I have loved you, saith the Lord”: God says he loves us. “Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us?” We say it because we catch hell all the time and these heathens keep kicking us; at the bottom of society, it doesn’t feel like God loves us. But God says, I love you, no matter if you live in the ghetto, no matter what you go through, no matter if you are descendants of slaves, no matter how our people are acting.

“Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau.” God hates Esau because he saw the future: all the evil and wicked atrocities and oppression the white man would do, from when he came into power as the Greeks, through the Romans, all the way up to America. God says he hates the white man, the Caucasians. We don’t hate them; God says he hates them. “and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.”

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places.” That is what he did in the Renaissance: the rebirth of Caucasian rule, coming back and rebuilding the places that were destroyed. “thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”. That tells you God is Judah, God is a black man: ain’t no damn white boy talking like that. The Lord says, they will build and I will throw down with them.

“and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” Indignation is righteous anger, and the Lord has it against them for ever. The Lord hates the Caucasians for ever, and they hate him too.

sense.text: “And all men are from the ground, and Adam was created of earth. In much knowledge the Lord hath divided them, and made their ways diverse.” In much knowledge God divided all the men he created, and made everybody’s ways different.

“Some of them hath he blessed and exalted”: that is Jacob, the twelve tribes of Israel, the so-called blacks and Hispanics. “and some of them hath he sanctified, and set near himself”.

“but some of them hath he cursed and brought low, and turned out of their places.” God cursed the Caucasian race; they are a cursed people. That goes back to Genesis 4. They are called Edom, and that is why there is no pigment in their skin: that is a curse.

“As the clay is in the potter’s hand, to fashion it at his pleasure: so man is in the hand of him that made him, to render to them as liketh him best.” God fashions everybody he created according to his pleasure. Some he chose to bring close to him, and some he created as a curse, to be evil and wicked.

“Good is set against evil, and life against death.” He made some good and some evil. Our people are made to look evil, with the twerking and the crimes they keep showing on television, while those bombing countries, killing millions of people and children and stealing whole countries’ resources call us thieves and criminals. Those God drew close to him are the good; the evil are those God cursed, and God cursed Esau.

“so is the godly against the sinner, and the sinner against the godly.” Those he drew close are the godly, those he cursed are the sinners, and they are set against each other. Of all the sons of Adam, he created some good and some evil, and the evil and the wicked of the earth is Esau. Look at the things he did.

“So look upon all the works of the most High; and there are two and two, one against another.” We are warring against each other. That is why people cannot stand us, and why the righteous of us cannot stand the evil that they do. God set good against evil, so if we are against the so-called white man, it is because of evil.

“There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.” The brothers and sisters are not supposed to be hoes.

A whore is not only a prostitute who sells her body for money, as the modern term has it. By the scripture, anyone who had sex outside of marriage played the whore: a young girl in her father’s house who slept with one guy before she married is still a whore. The woman at the well had five husbands, and the one she was with then was not her husband. A woman is supposed to be with one man for the rest of her life; sisters who have been with more than one man were hoes. A lot of us, before this truth, did not do things the right way: the brothers were whoremongers, and some of the sisters’ numbers are high.

Let the virgins marry each other: if you are not a virgin, you are not messing with a virgin. Why should a former whoremonger, or a sister who was promiscuous, marry a virgin? And a sister who has done other things is not a virgin in her mouth: she is defiled, and a virgin brother who will not have that is to be respected.

But if a sister has truly changed and repented, don’t ask her how many men she has been with: what do you want her to do, lie to you? You will always look at her with that and use it against her later. Just know what you are getting into, and prove each other before you marry. Sister, if you were promiscuous, let the brother know you are not innocent; and if you used to be a prostitute and sell it, tell him, because that is another level of demon. Brothers, it affects you equally: when you sleep with a woman, you put that woman’s spirit in you, and it changes your appetite, so that you cannot enjoy your wife properly. The two shall be one flesh.

precepts.why:
“Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away.” Paul was a murderer and did a lot, and Mary Magdalene, the sister who was always with Christ, had had devils cast out of her. In Christ we are all new creatures.

So the sister who used to be a whore is not a whore any more, if she has truly changed. And a new generation is coming up in this truth: there are many virgins amongst us, sisters and brothers both.

sense.text:
We do not hate. “Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he is thy brother: thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a stranger in his land.” In ancient Egypt the Egyptians oppressed us and did all kinds of evil to us, and Moses says, do not hate them.

It is the same thing as Romans 12, live peaceably: deal right with the people around you. Moses understood that they would enslave us in the future and would try to paint us as a hate group, so he gave us the way to deal with them from the beginning. This is a law, brothers: you should not be going around saying, I hate white people.

When the white man is judged and found guilty, that is not hatred. When a judge judges a murderer, a rapist or a thief, nobody says the judge hates the thief; when a rapist is put to death for raping a little girl, nobody says the judge hated him. So when we judge Esau and say he is guilty of enslaving us and bringing us here, of Jim Crow, of slavery, of lying and calling himself a Jew and a Christian, of killing the North American Indians and taking their land, we are not hating him. We charge them in the name of the Lord as thieves, murderers, rapists and mass murderers, and that is God’s judgment and justice. Our people do not understand justice: God says forgive, but he still has to be judged.

precepts.why:
When Christians run to Deuteronomy 23:7 to tell us we aren’t supposed to hate white folks, first, they acknowledge that Esau is the white man. Second, go two chapters on and see what changed.

“Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt; How he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.”

“Therefore it shall be, when the Lord thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it, that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; thou shalt not forget it.” So the law of Deuteronomy 23:7 is temporary: in the kingdom we will erase Amalek from existence.

And why would we blot them out? Not out of hatred, but judgment for what they have done. For centuries the white man has been robbing, stealing, murdering and raping, and he has never paid for it. It is our job to let him know judgment is coming, and that every evil thing he did is wrong. That is not hatred.

sense.text:
Some online are put off by us the way they were put off by Malcolm X, because we are blunt and plain: God hates the white man and he is going to pay for what he has done. Some have white parents, some love the white man, some try to bring him into their congregations, and we offend them. But blessed is he that is not offended in Christ.

“Who will rise up for me against the evildoers?” Who is going to rise up for God against the evildoers? The evildoers here are not first the Negroes selling drugs on the corner or stealing from the corner store; they are the people that are evil on this earth.

“or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?” They call us a hate group, but we are standing up against the workers of iniquity and letting them know they are wrong: wrong for robbing and stealing this country, wrong for stealing the Israelites and bringing us here, wrong for the murder.
“Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.” You would have stayed quiet if the Lord had not woken you up and been your help.

precepts.why:
“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen.” We are God’s witnesses, his servants, and he chose us. A witness testifies.

So when we, God’s witnesses, testify of the evil the white man has done on this earth, the murders, the mass murders, the genocide, the enslaving of our people, that is not hate. Our people confuse justice with hate. God is a righteous God; you will not rape and murder and commit genocide and think God forgot. The courtroom is this whole planet earth, and we are testifying that judgment is coming, that they will pay for the murder, the enslavement and the rape. Brothers, you must want justice: there are laws written in this Bible, and everybody that breaks them is going to pay for it.

“Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” This is what God’s witnesses do: they teach God’s testimonies and his laws. There are testimonies written in this book for Edom, and it is our job to teach them.

Here is an example. “Let us die all in our innocency: heaven and earth shall testify for us, that ye put us to death wrongfully.” That is what the white man was doing back then, the Greeks and the Romans.

Heaven and earth will testify for us that they put us to death wrongfully: the KKK put us to death wrongfully, and the British cavalry, the French, the Spanish, the Dutch and the English. It is the same thing.

sense.text: “But abide a while, and behold his great power, how he will torment thee and thy seed.” Wait a little while and you will see God’s great power: he will torment Antiochus, the Greeks, and his seed. The seed is his descendants.

“Be not deceived without cause: for we suffer these things for ourselves, having sinned against our God: therefore marvellous things are done unto us.” The white man was not able to enslave us and bring us here because he was so powerful; it was because we sinned against God. That is why all these things were done unto us.

“But think not thou, that takest in hand to strive against God, that thou shalt escape unpunished.” Don’t think the white man is going unpunished. Many say forget about slavery, forget the colonization, the rape and the murder; God says you will not go unpunished.

White people turn around and say, that was my forefathers, I wasn’t there, I didn’t do that to you; some with white guilt, some arrogant: that was the past, get over it. But the judgment is on the seed too.

precepts.why:
“Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous, And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.” That is what the Pharisees said, and it is the same thing white people say today: if we had been around back then, we would not have taken part in slavery.

“Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.” The same goes for the so-called white people who say we were not there, we did not do that: you are the children of them that enslaved us. As we read in 2 Maccabees, the judgment was not just for Antiochus but for his seed, his descendants, his race, his people.

White people benefit from slavery. If they were righteous, they would give this land back to the North American Indians, pay reparations to black people and put us back in the land of Israel, because they have the records and know who we really are. They are not sorry for anything, because they benefit from the murder, the rape and the theft their fathers committed.

“Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.” The same wickedness your fathers did, you are going to do, you evil bastards. White people in America say they weren’t there in slavery, but the same laws and the same things their grandparents did, they are doing today: they don’t want us voting any more, and they are changing the laws on our people.

sense.text:
“And then shall that Wicked be revealed.” Our job is to reveal the wicked. We reveal him because we are God’s witnesses, and when we testify we reveal that this man is the wicked, the murderer, the thief the Bible speaks of. And when we do that, he says: you are a hate group, you hate me. Don’t confuse justice and judgment with hatred. We do not hate them; we bring forth righteous judgment and justice for the evil done on the earth.

“whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”. Two things are happening. The spirit of the Lord’s mouth is us, the witnesses on the street, testifying against these wicked people; and he will destroy him with the brightness of his coming.

precepts.why:
“For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish: To the one we are the savour of death unto death.” When the white man smells us and hears our teaching, we are the savour of death unto death. They smell death, because we are not teaching salvation for them; we are teaching judgment, justice and death for them, for all the evil they have done. They are going to be gone from the earth.

“and to the other the savour of life unto life.” Some hear this gospel, that we are the Israelites and Christ is coming to redeem us out of slavery, and they are happy. Others hear it and know it means they are going to be put to death.

That is why they don’t want to hear our teaching, why we are hated and called a hate group, and why everybody asks, do you hate white people? No, we don’t. We are speaking God’s laws and his righteous judgment, and prophesying against all the evil they are doing on this earth.

sense.text:
“The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted.” The brokenhearted are our people. This is the gospel: to bind up the brokenhearted.

“to proclaim liberty to the captives”. The captives are the slaves here in America. We are proclaiming liberty to them, letting them know the Lord is coming to deliver them. That is the gospel, and it is the savour of death to others. The white man can put it together very quickly: if these black people are Israelites, judgment is coming for me; if Christ is a black man, then my people killed Christ’s people.

“To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance”. That goes back to Romans 12: do not avenge yourselves, wait on the Lord, because vengeance belongs to him. The day of the Lord’s vengeance is the day the Lord comes and brings vengeance on the white man for all the evil he has done on this earth.

They keep saying we hate white people. “Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel.” The white man has had a perpetual hatred toward us, and has shed the blood of the children of Israel. As a matter of fact, our people love the white man: they worship his god and wear his hair, 100% European hair in the package.

The white man hates us; we don’t hate him. Look at what he is doing to this day. We did not lynch him; he did those things to us, then turns around and says, you are racist, you teach hate, because we say God is going to judge him and let him know he is the wicked of the earth.

“by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end”. When our iniquity had an end, after they said they let us go out of slavery, they were supposed to leave us alone. Instead they set up Jim Crow and the KKK and keep oppressing us to this day; our people are still marching for civil rights.

Perpetual means it never stops. The southern white man said it himself: he was taught like this, he teaches his children like this and they will teach theirs. Six-year-old Ruby Bridges needed federal marshals for a whole year because white adults wanted her dead for going to school. In 1966 a white man said that if black families moved into Cicero they would be killed. That is the hatred they have against us.

Patrice Lumumba stood before the Belgian king to his face and said colonialism was over, and within months the CIA and Belgium had him killed and his body dissolved in acid. It is in their own congressional record, nobody was prosecuted, and they are still stealing the Congo’s resources to this day. They are going to pay for this. We don’t hate them, but there is judgment written in this book for what white people have done and are doing on this earth, and in teaching it, some of us will be killed and put in prison.

precepts.why:
“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them.” God will do to them according to their anger and their envy. The white man envies us: our dark skin, our lips, our hair, the shape of our sisters. He envies us because God chose us. They have offered our women money for their eggs, saying black people have a genetic superiority, and they seek to cultivate the melanin they take from us. In our lowest state, God let us keep what he took from them. So God says the white man envies us and hates us. Did we kidnap them, set up Jim Crow against them, rape them, or make laws to keep them out of certain areas? No.

“and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.” God will make himself known among his true Israelites when he judges Esau, because Esau envies and hates them. “And thou shalt know that I am the Lord, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” God heard them calling themselves Jews, calling themselves his people, saying that they are the Christ, and speaking against his people.

“Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.” When the white man talks against us, he talks against our God, and God takes it personally. Every evil thing the Christians, Trump and all of them say against us, and every time they call themselves Jews and are not, God hears it.

“When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate. As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee.” When they took us as slaves, they rejoiced and made merry with their Christmas and Thanksgiving. “thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it”: the Lord is going to destroy them. That is the judgment, and when they hear it they get upset and call us a hate group. “And they shall know that I am the Lord”: that is the Lord’s word every time he makes his point.

sense.text:
The white man has a guilt complex. Malcolm X said it: instead of removing the causes of the black man’s condition, he covers it up by accusing his accusers of teaching hate, when they are only exposing him. It is white guilt, white fragility, reverse psychology: a smoke screen thrown out, hate, anti-Semitic, while they drop bombs on people. The descendants of colonizers are not sorry; they are uncomfortable, and they would rather we shut up. But God tells us to reveal them, and we are not going to shut up.

“Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy.” This is what white people say: they don’t want us to prophesy, and when we prophesy, we are teaching the testimonies of the Lord. “they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.” They don’t want to take shame or feel uncomfortable. This was spoken of our people back then, but it applies the same to Esau: don’t prophesy to me, I don’t want to feel bad for what I did.

They say, why do you hate white people? Go and ask the animals why they hate white people.

“Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him.” Brothers, we are to stand with great boldness in the face of all them that afflicted and enslaved us, the white man. Don’t be on no Mickey Mouse thing. Don’t be afraid to speak the word of God, and don’t be afraid when they put that label on you for speaking truth: he hates, he hates. Those Jedi mind tricks should not work on us. The righteous is bold like a lion, afraid of no man and nothing. “and made no account of his labours”: he gave no account of our labours.

“When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear.” That is what they are starting to see. God’s spirit is going to rise up on thousands of brothers, and they will prophesy and teach, thus saith the Lord, with much boldness.

“and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for.” When the righteous man’s salvation happens, everyone else will call it strange, because they are not looking for it: not looking for a black man to come down from the sky, or for what they call UFOs beaming black people up. They think Christ is coming back for hugs and kisses, and they think Christ is a white man. When they see it, they will know: that is salvation, that is Jesus Christ.

“And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves.” When that destruction takes place and they see the righteous man delivered, they will be sorry within themselves: we were wrong, everything those Israelites were teaching was the truth.

“This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision.” Derision is treating someone with contempt, scorn or mocking laughter. They laughed at us, scorned and mocked us: that is a hate group, they are worthless, they are stupid. They will say, isn’t that the man we killed and said was part of a hate group, the man we hanged and said was in a cult, the sister we said was in a cult? “and a proverb of reproach”: they call us terrorists and a hate group and put us on their lists.

“We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour.” They thought our life was worthless because we have no power; all we have is the word of God. They think our end is without honour: we will just put these black Hebrew Israelites in jail and kill them.

“How is he numbered among the children of God, and his lot is among the saints!” This is what they will say within themselves: how is that man one of the children of God? He used to sell drugs, he used to do this and that. And his lot is among the saints.

“Therefore have we erred from the way of truth.” Everybody on this planet has heard from the way of truth, and we are the only ones speaking the way of truth on this earth, whether they believe it or not. All are being warned.

“and the light of righteousness hath not shined unto us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us.” They will say, we never understood the Bible, we never knew Christ. The sun of righteousness is Christ, as in Malachi 4. It never shone on them: Christ never chose them.

“We wearied ourselves in the way of wickedness and destruction.” The way of wickedness is Christianity, the false religion our people follow, worshipping the white image of Christ; and the lesbianism, homosexuality and all the sins of America they follow.

“yea, we have gone through deserts, where there lay no way”. The deserts are these churches, these false religions. “but as for the way of the Lord, we have not known it.” These Christians don’t know it. Nobody on this earth knows it except the Israelites; that can be said with all confidence. They will hear it and still kill us and put us in prison, but let the Lord’s will be done.

“What hath pride profited us? or what good hath riches with our vaunting brought us?” What did pride profit you, white people, Christians, black people? The pride of this world, all those riches: in the end they bring nothing but death and torment.

“All those things are passed away like a shadow, and as a post that hasted by; And as a ship that passeth over the waves of the water, which when it is gone by, the trace thereof cannot be found, neither the pathway of the keel in the waves.” All the wickedness and all the riches will be gone, with no trace of them left, like a bird through the air, of which “there is no token of her way to be found.”

The day is coming when all the riches of this world will be gone. To hell with the riches and to hell with your job. Parents, stop sending children to college for no reason: see what your people need and the problems in your community, then go to school to learn and come back and fix them, not to get rich in this world. This world is done. We are in the beginning of sorrows: they are taking away our civil rights, soon you will not be able to buy and sell, many will lose their jobs, and the doctor and the dentist will be cut off. Are you setting things up for that now?

The hope of the ungodly is “like dust that is blown away with the wind; like a thin froth that is driven away with the storm; like as the smoke which is dispersed here and there with a tempest, and passeth away as the remembrance of a guest that tarrieth but a day.”

“But the righteous live for evermore.” If you are righteous, you are going to live for evermore. The wicked and all the riches will fade away, but those who practise abstinence, do what is right and endure will live for evermore.

“their reward also is with the Lord”. You just have to endure all the wickedness that comes at you from the white man, from Edom. “and the care of them is with the most High.” You think God doesn’t care about you, but the care of us is with the Most High.
